div.div:
Every chat turn passes through the AgentGuard pipeline: ① identity resolved via SSO/OBO,
② input screened for injection (fail = blocked), ③ forwarded to backend agent,
④ output scanned for PII/DLP violations (fail = redacted), ⑤ audit event emitted with user attribution.
Governed by the registry entry 'teams-messaging-host'. Fail-open when aldi_shared is unavailable (demo mode).
